notes: The supplied page is not a requirements section for the IGETC Certificate of Achievement. It is '2026-2027 General Education Courses Common to Associate Degree Requirements and Cal-GETC': a flat list of courses that appear in both the local A.A./A.S. GE pattern and Cal-GETC.

The page prints no areas, no unit minimums, no rule for any group of courses, and no certificate total. No blocks were recorded, because any rule would have to be invented. Every closed-list course is explained in missing_explained instead.

The page names Cal-GETC, not IGETC. Cal-GETC replaced IGETC for students entering from Fall 2025. The reviewer should check whether the state's IGETC certificate record is stale, or whether a Cal-GETC certificate page (the 'California General Education Transfer Curriculum (Cal-GETC)' or 'Certificates' pages in the site menu) should be read instead.
ge_pattern is left null because this award is itself a GE-pattern certificate, not a degree that names a GE pattern.

The courses absent from the text are mostly first-semester world languages (e.g., SPAN 101, JPN 101, FREN 101) and science labs (BIOL 101, GEOG 101, GEOL 101, PHS 111, PHYS 271/273, ASTR 109). This is consistent with the page listing only courses common to both patterns, not the full Cal-GETC/IGETC area lists.
Many page courses are not on the closed list, for example ARCH 208, AJ 252, ASL 225, ANTH 115, ART 149, ASIA 117 and ENGL 115H. They were not recorded because no blocks were built.
The page prints no program learning outcomes and names no careers.
